This epic covers the design and implementation of a complete user authentication system for the application. It includes secure login mechanisms, password recovery workflows, account protection strategies, and integration with third-party authentication providers. The goal is to provide a reliable, scalable, and secure authentication experience for users while ensuring best practices in security and usability. This epic includes: Development of a user login interface Implementation of password recovery functionality Account security features (e.g., lock after multiple failed attempts) Integration with external authentication providers (Google, Facebook) Backend services and APIs for authentication Database design and user data management CI/CD setup and infrastructure preparation This epic will serve as the foundation for user management and access control within the system.
